title: The Reach, Surveyed
text: The furrows are surveyed and the samples are sealed. The Reach is still the worst place on the planet to make camp, and we have made one. It will be here if we come back.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The convoy turns for home. The Burrowers don't look up.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay. The Burrowers plough round the camp as if it had always been there.
